source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination, 'In all the other Divisions the candidates nominated are returned unopposed' (page image, Frontier Sentinel, 29 April 1933, p. 5); no withdrawals in the four contested divisions (Newry Telegraph, 4 May 1933, p. 5); present at the new council's annual meeting (Newry Reporter, 1 June 1933, p. 10)

note: Triennial election of the nineteen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled in County Down on 25 May 1933. Four divisions were contested (Ballymartin, Kilkeel North, Maghera, Rostrevor); in the other fifteen the sole nominee was returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
